question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Farmers are urged to ________ to good agricultural practices in the disposal and spreading of agricultural wastes such as slurry.
solution:
The correct answer is - **'Adhere'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **In the given options the **correct word** to fill in the blanks is **'Adhere'.**
 
• The meaning of **Adhere **is** to stick firmly to something.**
 
 
• Example: While working on the project, make sure that you** adhere to** the guidelines.
 
 
 
• **"Adhere"** is a verb that is commonly used with the preposition **"to"** to indicate that someone or something is sticking to a particular rule, standard, or belief.
 
 
• For example, "He always **adheres to** his principles" or "The glue will **adhere to** the surface of the wood."
 
• In both of these sentences, "adhere" is used with the preposition "to" to indicate a sense of conformity or attachment to something.
 
 
 
• ​Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Complete Sentence:**__ *Farmers are urged to __**adhere**__ to good agricultural practices in the disposal and spreading of agricultural wastes such as slurry.*​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The meaning of **Disturb** is ***to cause somebody to worry**.*
 
• The meaning of **Gather** is ***to bring many things together.***
 
• The meaning of **Worship** is ***to pray to and show respect for God or a god**.*
 
• The meaning of **Slurry** is ***a thick liquid consisting of water mixed with animal waste that farmers use on their fields to make plants grow better.***
